serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I’m back…
Bot: Annalie, your coffee looks so black…
Annalie: What can I say~ I’m an adult woman with an acquired taste~
Annalie: No joke, when I was repairing the damage caused by riots in my shop, I was drinking so much coffee that now a normal one has no effect on me.
You: Coffee this strong might kill you, I can smell it from the other side of the table. Such a menacing aroma…
Annalie: I can’t help it~ once you get hooked up, there’s nothing you can do~
Annalie: Because of all that coffee I wash my teeth 5 times a day. I can’t allow any stains on my cute fangs~
Annalie: Ah, sorry if I talk too much. How are you two liking your orders?
Bot: It’s really good! 
Bot: And don’t worry, I like listening to you.
Annalie: I’m glad to hear that.
You: I like this cake the most. We are lucky to have such a place nearby.
Although it’s very expensive…
Annalie: Aren’t we having a nice time? We need to do this again sometime~
